desc: baseline model (hgb settings unchanged) + features: inorganic_floor_pct = sum_i w_i * yield_i (stoichiometric: ATH->Al2O3 0.654, MDH->MgO 0.69, silica/clay/glass/metal oxides/ZnO/TiO2 1.0, carbon or glass fibre 1.0 on fibre_wtpct); neat_char_pct = mean residue of TRAINING-fold matrix rows (fibre 0) with the same system and same FR set and P_pct, else same system with no FR, else all training matrix rows, always excluding the row itself; floor_pct = inorganic_floor_pct + (1 - fibre_wtpct/100) * neat_char_pct; P-based char-promoter features P_APP, P_RDP, P_TEDAP (wt% P from each FR, from fr1/fr2 loading in wt% P) and is_P_promoter flag. Computed in-fold for every split.

full_fit.protocol: training fit (same protocol as BME: full-dataset fit)
